meta.note: A recognition aid, not part of the official catalogue. Per question: one rare word in the stem (trigger) and one string that appears in no other option of that question (token). Scan the stem for the trigger to know which question this is, then pick the option carrying the token — without reading the German. Every token is verified to occur in the correct option and in none of its siblings. Grades: A = trigger unique within a 310 pool and token never appears in a wrong option anywhere; B = one of those two holds; C = token distinctive within its own question only; D = no single distinctive word, so a verbatim phrase is given; V = picture question, token is the image number.
meta.matching: token = substring unless match is 'exact', which means the correct option is exactly the token and a wrong option contains it as a prefix (Sachsen vs Niedersachsen, weiss-rot vs blau-weiss-rot). Absent 'match' means substring. Absent 'state' means a general question. A few questions carry stem_ambiguous: their stem is shared with another question (sometimes word for word), so the trigger cannot tell you which one you are looking at — ignore the stem and go by the token alone, which still resolves to exactly one option.
